name: chandrayaan-anatomy
description: Interactive 3D technical drawing of Chandrayaan-1, 2 and 3: the spacecraft part by part, the PSLV-XL and LVM3 rockets that launched them, every engine down to its turbopumps, the landings replayed, and all three journeys on a to-scale map of the Earth and Moon.
author: M. Sree Ganesh
